title: Kinetic type machine
technique: Moving poster typography: every letter is its own small rectangle cut from a font sheet and animated by a shader.
music: The beat steps the scrolling lines, typing, word changes and giant counting numerals, while kick drums jolt and scatter the letters, snares flip the colours and hi-hats light up single letters. Louder passages open the layouts up, and each new section of the song swaps in another phrase and arrangement.
as_processor: Prints the picture as a two-colour line screen in the take's flat colours, inside the moving type and more faintly behind it, so big letters and numerals become windows onto it; the mosaic take turns it into a halftone made of letters, and rings and ticker wall also size every letter by the brightness of the picture under it.

takes.name: Flash cards
takes.description: One heavy word per beat, stretched to fill most or all of the frame, with the snare flipping the card to its negative.
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen faintly behind the type

takes.name: Mosaic
takes.description: A full-frame field of small letters with text streaming through it, where the cells under a giant counting numeral swell and darken and kicks shake the numeral apart; there is no headline.
words: EVERY CELL IS ONE GLYPH QUAD.
TEXT STEPS A CELL PER EIGHTH.
MOSAIC: 1296 GLYPH CELLS. THE ONES UNDER THE BIG NUMERAL SWELL.
MOSAIC: 2304 GLYPH CELLS. THE ONES UNDER THE BIG NUMERAL SWELL.
MOSAIC: 576 GLYPH CELLS. THE ONES UNDER THE BIG NUMERAL SWELL.
MOSAIC: 920 GLYPH CELLS. THE ONES UNDER THE BIG NUMERAL SWELL.
takes.input: halftone of letters: every cell sized by the picture under it, the numeral only tinting bright cells

takes.name: Echo
takes.description: One or two big words with a stack of copies behind them in alternating colours, like a striped extrusion that stays tight in quiet beats and shoots out on kicks.
words: 26 COPIES OF ONE WORD. KICKS PUSH THE STACK OUT.
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the front word; the same screen faintly behind the type

takes.name: Diagonal marquee
takes.description: Tilted bands of scrolling phrases in two typefaces running in opposite directions at different speeds, with the tilt jolting on the snare.
words: LURCH ON THE BEAT, THEN COAST
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen clearly behind the type

takes.name: Roll call
takes.description: A black and white list of phrases that steps up one line per beat through a white bar that enlarges the current line, with kicks jolting alternate lines apart.
words: ONE LINE STEPS UP PER BEAT
THE WHITE GATE ENLARGES ITS LINE
INK INSIDE THE GATE IS KNOCKED OUT
KICKS JOLT ODD AND EVEN LINES APART
EVERY LETTER IS ITS OWN QUAD
ONE VERTEX SHADER PLACES THEM ALL
LAYOUTS BAKED INTO A FLOAT TEXTURE
SET IN ONE FACE, BLACK AND WHITE ONLY
ORTHOGRAPHIC CAMERA, ONE UNIT PER PIXEL
POSITION IS A FUNCTION OF THE BEAT
takes.input: line screen of the picture faintly behind the type

takes.name: Counter
takes.description: Three giant counting numerals filling the frame edge to edge, with thin columns of text running vertically between them and an inverted area rising over two bars.
words: THE BAR AT THE FOOT FILLS EACH BEAT
THREE DIGITS OF A LIVE COUNTER
THE INVERSION LINE RISES OVER TWO BARS
NUMERALS CUT FROM A 462 PIXEL ATLAS
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen faintly behind the type

takes.name: Accordion
takes.description: Rows of a repeated word scrolling in alternating directions, squashed and stretched as a bulge of height travels through the rows once a bar.
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen faintly behind the type

takes.name: Rings
takes.description: Phrases set around concentric circles, each ring with its own size, typeface, speed and direction, usually centred off the frame so the type crosses it in arcs.
words: EACH RING HAS ITS OWN SIZE, FACE AND SPEED
RINGS LURCH ON THE BEAT, THEN COAST
EVERY LETTER IS ITS OWN QUAD
EACH GLYPH RIDES ITS CIRCLE BY ANGLE
TYPE RESIZED SO THE PHRASE CLOSES THE RING
ARCHIVO BLACK, BARLOW CONDENSED AND A MONO
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen faintly behind the type; every letter sized and coloured by the picture under it

takes.name: Swiss columns
takes.description: A grid layout with a bar number as tall as the frame beside a headline that types itself out above a rule and a small numbered list.
words: THE BIG NUMBER IS THE BAR.
A GRID, A RULE, A NUMBER, A LIST.
EVERY LETTER IS ITS OWN QUAD.
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the big numerals; the same screen faintly behind the type

takes.name: Exploded letters
takes.description: A sentence holds together for one bar, then every letter jumps to its own cell of a coarse grid, turned and rescaled, before assembling again.
words: ONE BAR A SENTENCE, NEXT BAR A GRID.
EVERY LETTER IS ITS OWN QUAD.
32 CELLS, 8 X 4. A NEW ORDER EVERY CYCLE.
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen faintly behind the type

takes.name: Ticker wall
takes.description: Nine to eighteen rows of scrolling phrases at different speeds and directions over one huge beat numeral, with an inverted band sweeping across each bar.
words: EVERY ROW HAS ITS OWN SPEED AND DIRECTION
ROWS LURCH ON THE BEAT, THEN COAST
THE BIG NUMERAL IS THE BEAT IN THE BAR
AN INVERTED BAND SWEEPS ONCE A BAR
SOME ROWS CLOSE WHEN THE MUSIC IS QUIET
A MONO FACE AND BARLOW CONDENSED
EVERY LETTER IS ITS OWN QUAD
POSITION IS A FUNCTION OF THE BEAT
28 NUMBERS PER GLYPH, BAKED INTO A TEXTURE
takes.input: line screen of the picture faintly behind the type; every letter sized and coloured by the picture under it

takes.name: Typewriter
takes.description: A sentence typed one character per sixteenth note in a large fixed-width face with a block cursor, filling the frame over a huge cropped catalogue number scrolling behind.
words: TYPED ONE GLYPH PER SIXTEENTH NOTE.
THE CURSOR IS A QUAD TOO.
A SENTENCE, THEN A HOLD, THEN AGAIN.
TYPEWRITER: 4 GLYPHS A BEAT, BLOCK CURSOR, 150 PX TYPE
takes.input: line screen of the picture inside the ink; the same screen faintly behind the type
